Before
you begin.

How do I ask about admissions or scholarships?

Choose “Admissions and scholarships” in the enquiry tool and ask the Institute for current application dates, eligibility and submission instructions.

Does this form send my message?

It prepares a message for you to copy. Open the Instagram account selected for your enquiry, paste your message, and review it before sending.

Can I upload application documents here?

This website does not accept application documents. Ask the Institute for its approved submission process.

Privacy, with care.

This website introduces The Safwa and its initiatives. It does not provide accounts, receive applications or accept document uploads.

The enquiry tool prepares a message in your browser. It does not send your message to a server or save your form entries in website storage. When you choose “Copy message”, the text is placed on your device’s clipboard.

Instagram and WhatsApp open separately. You choose whether to send a message or join the community. Those services handle information under their own policies.

This site includes no advertising trackers or visitor analytics. Hosting providers may process routine connection information needed to serve the website.
